title: 96 well spin column TNA extraction from plants - CTAB method
author: James JN Kitson
materials: Borosilicate glass beaker or Duran bottle

steps.title: Prepare steel beads
steps.instruction: Obtain three 3 mm hardened carbon steel or stainless steel beads per sample tube; if beads are oil‑coated, place them in a glass beaker and bake at 250 °C for at least 12 hours to remove manufacturing oil.

steps.title: Prepare CTAB lysis buffer
steps.instruction: Mix per litre: 20 g CTAB (2 %), 20 g polyvinyl‑pyrrolidone (2 %), 10 ml 1 M Tris‑HCl (final 10 mM), 40 ml 0.5 M EDTA (final 20 mM), 69.54 g ammonium chloride (1.3 M). Keep the buffer fresh for use.

steps.title: Freeze tubes and grind tissue
steps.instruction: Place frozen sample tubes in a tissue homogeniser, add three steel beads per tube, and grind at 1750 RPM for 4–5 minutes in 2‑minute batches.

steps.title: Add CTAB buffer to ground material
steps.instruction: For dried plant material add 700 µl CTAB buffer; for fresh material add 500 µl. Mix at low speed using a tube shaker, vortex mixer, or homogeniser until the powder is thoroughly suspended.

steps.title: Incubate lysate
steps.instruction: Incubate the mixture at 55 °C for 60 minutes.

steps.title: Centrifuge to pellet debris
steps.instruction: Centrifuge at 1500 × g for 5 minutes and retain the supernatant.

steps.title: Prepare 5 ml collection tubes
steps.instruction: Fill 5 ml tubes (e.g., Starlab #E1450‑1100) with three 3 mm steel beads; prepare batches of 90 tubes.

steps.title: Aliquot plant material into tubes
steps.instruction: Using sterile forceps, place ~50 mg dried (or 100 mg fresh) plant material into each pre‑beaded tube and label with sample ID.

steps.title: Freeze samples
steps.instruction: Place the tubes in zip‑lock bags (batches of 90) and freeze at –80 °C until extraction proceeds.

steps.title: Transfer supernatant to filter plate
steps.instruction: Move 350 µl of cleared supernatant to each well of a 96‑well filter plate (NBS #SD5006) positioned on a 1‑2 ml deep‑well plate; seal with a breathable plate seal (Starlab #E2796‑3005). Add 350 µl CTAB buffer to two designated negative‑control wells.

steps.title: Add isopropanol and mix
steps.instruction: Add 350 µl 100 % isopropanol to each well and vortex to mix.

steps.title: Centrifuge after isopropanol
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the plate at 1500 × g for 5 minutes to pellet any remaining fine particulates.

steps.title: Load supernatant onto spin columns
steps.instruction: Transfer as much supernatant as possible from each well to a corresponding 96‑well silica‑membrane spin column (NBS SD5007) placed on a deep‑well plate; avoid disturbing sediment and cover with a breathable seal.

steps.title: Wash spin columns with ethanol
steps.instruction: Add 500 µl 70 % ethanol to each column, centrifuge at 1500 × g for 5 minutes; repeat this wash two more times (total three washes). After the final wash, spin for 10 minutes to dry the membrane.

steps.title: Elute nucleic acid
steps.instruction: Transfer the spin columns to a new 0.5 ml deep‑well plate, add 50–100 µl water or 10 mM Tris‑HCl, incubate 10 minutes at room temperature, then centrifuge at 1500 × g for 1 minute. Collect the flow‑through containing the extracted TNA.

steps.title: Final filtration and storage
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the eluate at 1500 × g for 1 minute to filter; store the purified TNA at –20 °C until needed.
